name: W Riyadh - KAFD
positioning: The W brand's debut in Saudi Arabia, in the heart of Riyadh's King Abdullah Financial District, with a WET Deck pool, cabanas and an AWAY Spa
best_for: Travelers who want a stylish base in the King Abdullah Financial District, near KAFD Metro
Guests who want a pool deck and spa between city days

facts.text: The hotel rises within the capital's most future-forward skyline.
Rooms have smart controls and ambient lighting.
Rooms blend contemporary design with local influence.
Rooms and suites feature bold textures and sculptural lines.
AWAY Spa offers signature treatments and detox rituals.
The FIT gym has cutting-edge equipment and expert trainers.
Beni pairs craft coffee with artisanal ice cream.
W Lounge serves signature cocktails to curated beats, in a space where fashion, art and music collide.
KAFD Metro is a nearby subway station.

highlights.text: W Riyadh - KAFD is the W brand's debut in the Kingdom.
W Riyadh - KAFD is in the heart of Riyadh's King Abdullah Financial District.
Private poolside cabanas surround the WET Deck, with an outdoor bar and DJ beats.
AWAY Spa has steam and sauna facilities.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the financial-district location may feel removed from Riyadh's traditional cultural landmarks.
